title: Approval
description: A proposed or in-flight approval of an `fdc3.action`. Used as the input to `GetApproval`, `UpdateApproval`, `CancelApproval`, `ViewApproval` and `ReviewApproval`, and as the IntentResult of `UpdateApproval` and `CancelApproval`. `subject` is the action to perform if approved. `status` is the lifecycle state: omit it or send `pending` when raising `GetApproval`; the approving application assigns `id.approvalId` and updates `status` as the decision proceeds. `cancelled` is produced by `CancelApproval` (or by the approving application invalidating the request). `GetApproval`'s IntentResult is still the target application's result, forwarded by the approving application — not this context.

id.title: Approval identifiers
id.description: FDC3 context `id` map. `requestId` is the caller-generated correlation and retry identifier, scoped by the provider to the authenticated caller. `approvalId` is the durable identifier assigned by the approving application after it accepts the request. At least one is required.

requestId.title: requestId
requestId.description: Caller-generated correlation and retry identifier. Reusing this identifier with a different subject or request content is an error. Identical request IDs from different callers must not collide.

approvalId.title: approvalId
approvalId.description: Durable identifier assigned by the approving application.

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: The `fdc3.action` that needs approval. After a terminal `approved` decision, the approving application performs this action (`raiseIntent` or `broadcast`) once, signed as itself, and forwards the target's IntentResult to the raising application.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Explanation of why approval is being requested. Informational; the approving application validates the applicable policy.

status.title: Status
status.description: Lifecycle state. Omit or send `pending` when raising `GetApproval`. The initial lifecycle is `pending` followed by one terminal outcome (`approved`, `rejected`, `cancelled`, or `expired`). Terminal approvals are not reopened.

updatedAt.title: Updated at
updatedAt.description: Time of the state snapshot, as an RFC 3339 timestamp.

expiresAt.title: Expires at
expiresAt.description: Review deadline as an RFC 3339 timestamp. Present only while `status` is `pending`. The approving application may enforce a different deadline than the one requested. Omitted after a terminal outcome — the deadline no longer applies.

decisionReason.title: Decision reason
decisionReason.description: Explanation accompanying the final outcome, where appropriate to disclose.
